name: Nilrebmah II
description: Nilrebmah II was a planet in the Nilrebmah system. The atmosphere of the world was fluorine-based. It's desert-covered surface was cratered, due to the fact that its atmosphere was filled with asteroids which made frequent impact on the surface. It was the homeworld of an unidentified civilization.
